inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, taking-notes.md, sample paper note, backlog, website config, and GitHub Pages workflow

anchors.why: Lists books, talks, articles, and papers with author/year metadata and note links.
Explains medium-specific note-taking and recall process.
Shows short paper summary with source link and structured sections.
Lists future articles and papers without treating them as processed knowledge.
Configures Jekyll/Just-the-Docs projection and folder defaults.
Builds and deploys the website from the website folder to GitHub Pages.

known_limits: Summaries are recall artifacts and not retained source text.
Copyright and quotation boundaries matter for external source notes.
